scenario: Two reads in one PostgreSQL transaction return different committed values. Explain the default isolation behavior.
rubric: Read Committed takes a fresh snapshot for each statement.
Explain how a concurrent commit can become visible to the later statement.
Contrast Repeatable Read and discuss retry requirements for stricter isolation.
Explain the approach in a clear sequence with assumptions and an example.
misconceptions: Every transaction automatically uses one fixed snapshot for all statements.
